summary.text: John Vlahos, the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate for the U.S. House in Michigan's 9th District, lost the November 3, 2026 election to Lisa McClain.
Vlahos received 0.4% of the vote to Lisa McClain's 62.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
Vlahos advanced from the party's July 18, 2026 convention; little biographical information is available in public sources.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
